source_name: Improved Classification Approach dataset (Mukhiddinov et al., Sensors 2022)
vegetables: Potato; Carrot; Tomato; Cucumber; Bell pepper
verified_fresh_rotten_counts: Paper reports Potato 615/585; Carrot 620/580; Tomato 604/596; Cucumber 608/593; Bell pepper 611/591 (Fresh/Rotten). Total 12,000 images across 5 veg + 5 fruit.
label_quality: Article says directory/classes were freshness organized and images manually annotated for YOLO; collected from Kaggle, Google, Bing and mobile phone. Not independently inspected. Mix of single and multiple objects; not a pure image-level single-object set.
license_and_terms: Article is CC BY. Dataset/archive license not established by article license; verify current Kaggle terms and rights for constituent images.
image_provenance: Multi-source aggregation; exact original provenance/attribution per image not reported in article.
download_availability: Paper links a public Kaggle dataset; no archive downloaded. Current exact version, size and license need confirmation.
suitability: Best balanced-count lead for Potato, Carrot, Tomato, Cucumber, Bell Pepper after license and overlap checks.
risks: Could overlap with Mendeley FoodClass extraction or Kaggle mirrored copies; avoid double counting. Annotation task is YOLO detection; binary labels require extraction and review. Rotten rubric and source identities unclear.

source_name: AgriFreshNET Freshness and Shelf-Life Image Dataset v1
vegetables: Target category mapping not visible in landing metadata; 24 fruit/vegetable classes asserted
verified_fresh_rotten_counts: 14,500 RGB images; Fresh/Semi-Fresh/Rotten categories stated; per-target vegetable counts not visible in record metadata reviewed.
label_quality: Explicit freshness-stage scheme claimed by publisher; no per-image class listing inspected.
image_provenance: Publisher says local markets, supermarkets, households, farms, storage; per-image source/attribution details not verified from landing page.
download_availability: Mendeley record offers Raw Data and Processed_Data files; size and category-level manifests need review before any download.
suitability: Promising broad lead if metadata confirms target vegetables and class counts; do not collapse Semi-Fresh automatically.
risks: Per-target class names/counts, data quality, overlap with existing data, per-image rights provenance and exact binary Fresh/Rotten mapping remain unverified.

source_name: Image Dataset of Red and White Onion Bulbs and Leaves
verified_fresh_rotten_counts: 16,300 total: 12,260 bulbs, 4,040 leaves; no Fresh/Rotten class counts on landing record. Variety (red/white), health status (healthy/unhealthy), and arrangement are described.
label_quality: Metadata workbook listed; healthy/unhealthy is not verified as Fresh/Rotten. Bulbs are produce; exclude leaf images. No image-level class counts verified.
license_and_terms: Zenodo record displayed no license value in Rights section when checked; treat terms as unresolved.
image_provenance: Authors describe market acquisition in Pune, India, smartphone capture, serial identifiers and metadata workbook.
download_availability: Public 1.6 GB ZIP plus 1.3 MB metadata workbook listed; no download performed.
suitability: Onion bulb images are a valuable visual-data lead but are not yet a Fresh/Rotten dataset.
risks: Healthy/unhealthy meaning, class counts, photo-label mapping, per-image rights, and separation of bulbs from leaves require metadata review; 1.6 GB is large for casual review.

verified_fresh_rotten_counts: 293 paired images/92 physical onion groups; reported class totals across splits: HEALTHY 123, DAMAGED 45, ROTTEN 75, SPROUTED 50. Split counts and labels are in repository README.
label_quality: Explicit four-class visible quality labels. Only ROTTEN is directly aligned; HEALTHY may be a Fresh proxy only after rubric review. Do not auto-merge DAMAGED or SPROUTED.
license_and_terms: Repository says refer to repository for applicable terms; no clear image-dataset license was verified.
image_provenance: Project claims onion prototype dataset and physical-group split; original photo provenance/permission not documented in the visible README.
download_availability: Public GitHub repository; no download performed.
suitability: Small, focused lead for onion manual review if authors grant/clarify reuse rights.
risks: Small, prototype-sized and not representative; images are paired and grouped; class mismatch; no verified license or raw image source. Model metrics are not evidence of label suitability for FreshGuard.

source_name: VegQual / Fresh and Defective Vegetables dataset
vegetables: Tomato; Potato; Onion; Capsicum plus bitter gourd, pointed gourd, brinjal
verified_fresh_rotten_counts: Paper reports 2,032 raw images and 4,736 annotated instances across fresh/defective classes for seven vegetables; category-wise binary counts not fully verified.
label_quality: Explicit Fresh/Defective detection labels; defective is not necessarily Rotten. Includes box annotations; use only after careful crop-level label interpretation and human review.
license_and_terms: No clear dataset license verified in the landing repository/paper information checked.
image_provenance: Paper says collected from local markets; original image provenance not fully available in checked metadata.
download_availability: GitHub/related paper available; cited Figshare dataset path; no download performed.
suitability: Lead for market-scene onion, tomato, potato and capsicum images, not direct binary classifier training yet.
risks: Fresh/defective semantic mismatch; class counts incomplete; access archive and license unverified; detection annotations must not be confused with image-level condition labels.

verified_fresh_rotten_counts: Record reports 1,600 total; says original set 800 with 400 training originals and 200 each validation/test; 1,200 augmented training samples are derived, not independent original photos.
label_quality: Record describes manually boxed Fresh and Rotten labels. Detection task; image labels may have valid classes but inspect annotation/image structure and keep augmented variants grouped.
license_and_terms: Record reports CC BY 4.0; still retain source and attribution and verify underlying image rights.
image_provenance: Record says collected from various sources; no per-image original-source ledger verified.
download_availability: 42 MB zip listed on Mendeley; Roboflow Universe export referenced; no download performed.
suitability: Potential tomato supplement after license review, overlap check, augmentation de-duplication and confirmation of binary image labels.
risks: Augmented samples inflate apparent size; dataset provenance, original split leakage and exact source overlap unresolved.

source_name: Good and Bad classification of Cucumber (Cucumis Sativus)
verified_fresh_rotten_counts: Record states 500 good and 500 bad images.
label_quality: Explicit Good/Bad folders; equivalence to Fresh/Rotten is unverified. Record says mature/fresh cucumber collection; inspect what BAD means and whether images show spoilage.
image_provenance: Described as collected from local markets in Malda, India; attribution/individual source records not verified.
download_availability: Public Mendeley record; no download performed; file size not established in this review.
suitability: Small candidate for cucumber manual review if class meaning and image quality pass.
risks: Good/Bad may encode defects/appearance rather than rotting; no class rubric or independent label validation inspected.

verified_fresh_rotten_counts: 6,850 images total across four vegetables; no per-class or per-quality counts verified in landing metadata.
label_quality: Five quality folders: Unripe, Ripe, Old, Dried, Damaged; not Fresh/Rotten. Do not map automatically.
image_provenance: Published dataset record; image-level origin not verified in this audit.
download_availability: Public Mendeley record; no download performed.
suitability: Possible source for condition-boundary manual research for Bell Pepper and Tomato, not direct binary training.
risks: Ripeness and damage are distinct from spoilage; class mapping and per-image provenance unresolved.

source_name: FoodClass: Fruit, Vegetable, Meat, Fish v2 (already present)
vegetables: Potato; Tomato; Carrot; Cucumber; Capsicum/Bell Pepper; no Onion
verified_fresh_rotten_counts: Local inventory counts are in existing_dataset_reassessment.csv; all 5 populated veg categories have explicit directory labels.
label_quality: Fresh/Rotten directory names; no published label rubric; 336 cross-label exact-hash groups overall, including 17 Carrot and 3 Tomato.
license_and_terms: Record CC BY 4.0; image-level rights remain unresolved because record says aggregated from public repositories.
image_provenance: Existing local extracted data; 37,762 inventory rows across the six requested category keys, including zero Onion; source/path preserved.
download_availability: Already available locally; no new acquisition.
suitability: Use only as a human-review pool pending provenance, label and duplicate remediation.
risks: Do not treat folder label as ground truth; exact conflicts and repeated files; possible source/domain leakage.
